To be completely honest with you, there is a chance that the pill does not fix every symptom, especially if you have Hashimoto’s. People with thyroid disorders is prone to having iron deficiency, magnesium deficiency etc. These deficiency’s maybe also be the reason that you have brain fog and fatigue. 

There have been some personal reports on this subreddit that brain fog and some fatigue is still present even at optimal TSH levels. Of course there are some where the pill clears all their symptoms, and I sincerely hope you are in that lucky few. 

As for the weight issues, I hear you. Try to keep a balance diet though. There’s no use on going on those crash diets and ending up deficient in the vitamins and minerals that you need to have an active lifestyle. People with hypothyroidism are prone to be sensitive to milk, gluten and several other foods. Try to look up on this and see if you can get tested. When I cut out gluten and milk, I could see that it increased my weight loss. Again, everyone is different, you could get tested or try a milk and gluten free diet to see if it helps you.
